name: Rice-paper rolls with boiled pork
nameVi: Bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo luộc
summary: Boiled or steamed belly pork in rice paper from Hoà Đa, Đông Bình, and Phường Lụa. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note serves the rolls to guests and at breakfast, with a fish sauce of cá cơm, cá sặc, and cá thu. A Tuy Hòa street and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note. The rice paper is from three villages, not from a Tuy Hòa shop.
howToEat: Boil or steam belly pork that has both lean and fat, and slice it thin. Roll it in rice paper with lettuce, herbs, cucumber, and green banana.
Dip the roll in fish sauce made from cá cơm, cá sặc, and cá thu. The note serves it to guests at a party and at breakfast. A price is Check on arrival.
where: The rice paper comes from Hoà Đa in xã An Mỹ, Đông Bình in xã Hoà An, and Phường Lụa in thị trấn Chí Thạnh. A street in Tuy Hòa for the meal was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Rice-paper rolls with boiled pork — three Phu Yen villages
seoDescription: Belly pork in rice paper from Hoa Da, Dong Binh, and Phuong Lua, with a fish sauce of anchovy, gourami, and mackerel. A Tuy Hoa street is Check on arrival.
